spec_features.spec_quote: It also lets the loop terminate naturally when a model truly quits, rather than forcing it to keep emitting.
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool defined in TOOL_SPECS (environment.py:106) and listed to the model via build_system_prompt (prompts.py:40). dispatch() routes it (environment.py:183-184) to give_up() which sets self.gave_up=True (environment.py:167-170). The rollout loop checks `if env.gave_up:` and executes `break`, ending the loop early and setting transcript.abandoned=True (runner.py:133-138). Fully wired end-to-end: tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced exit. Loop stops emitting once the subject calls give_up. n_abandoned is also aggregated (runner.py:180-186) but the exit itself is the enforced mechanism.
